meta.name: prd-securability-enhancement
meta.description: Enhance product requirement documents (PRDs) with FIASSE/SSEM implementation guidance and OWASP ASVS requirement coverage. Use when users ask to improve PRD security requirements, select an ASVS level, map feature requirements to ASVS controls, annotate features with SSEM attributes, and apply FIASSE foundational tenets across each feature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为产品需求文档注入安全合规要求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在PRD中系统性地加入安全需求与OWASP ASVS覆盖
copy.tagline_en: Inject security compliance into product requirement documents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically add security requirements and OWASP ASVS coverage to PRDs

howto.what: Claude 会分析你的产品需求文档（PRD），为每个功能添加安全需求、实施说明和可衡量的验收标准，并输出 ASVS 等级选择、覆盖矩阵和更新后的功能规格。
howto.when: 当你要求改进 PRD 的安全需求、选择 ASVS 等级、将功能映射到 ASVS 控制项，或为功能添加 FIASSE/SSEM 属性时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这份 PRD 加上安全需求，选 ASVS 2 级。
say.note: Claude 会解析 PRD 并生成安全增强版本。

say.text: 把登录功能映射到 ASVS 认证要求。
say.note: Claude 会识别相关 ASVS 章节并标记覆盖情况。

say.text: 为支付功能添加 FIASSE 安全属性注释。
say.note: Claude 会写入紧凑的安全实施说明。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your PRD, adds security requirements, implementation notes, and measurable acceptance criteria for each feature, and outputs ASVS level selection, coverage matrix, and updated feature specs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to improve PRD security requirements, select an ASVS level, map features to ASVS controls, or annotate features with FIASSE/SSEM attributes.

say_en.text: Enhance this PRD with security requirements, choose ASVS level 2.
say_en.note: Claude parses the PRD and generates a security-enhanced version.

say_en.text: Map the login feature to ASVS authentication requirements.
say_en.note: Claude identifies relevant ASVS sections and marks coverage.

say_en.text: Add FIASSE security attribute notes for the payment feature.
say_en.note: Claude writes compact securability implementation notes.
